title: LA City General Fund postings, September 2025 vs September 2024

attempts.text: In September 2025, the General Fund postings decreased by 0.2% compared to September 2024, marking a reduction of $1.3 million. The Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration experienced a decrease of $65.4 million, while the Fire department saw an increase of $37.0 million.
